description: This file defines the LogicalSearchFilter interface within a Java package for the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents a composite search filter that combines multiple SearchFilters using boolean logic (AND, OR) and includes methods to retrieve nested filters and a string representation.

classes.name: LogicalSearchFilter
classes.description: An interface representing a logical composite search filter that consolidates multiple SearchFilter instances with boolean operators.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns a collection of constituent SearchFilters concatenated by this logical filter, indicating the filters involved in the logical operation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the logical filter, showing the logical operation and its nested filters.
